title: 第11章 黑夜首杀第12章 余波上门
slug: 从一证永证开始成神第432章
content_zh:
;;
夜色压得很低。
哑巷口那盏油灯在风里晃了两下，火苗一下缩细，像是随时都会灭。
张屠正揪着一个妇人的头发，把人死死按在墙上。
妇人的额头已经破了，血糊在砖面上，顺着墙缝往下淌。
张屠没吼，也没显得多生气。
他只是把手里的竹板轻轻一合。
啪。
声音不大。
可这一声落下，周围几个人都下意识缩了缩脖子。
“巷钱。”
张屠语气平平：
“明天再凑不出来，你那两个儿子，就去巷口跪着学规矩。”
妇人浑身发抖，嘴唇都在哆嗦，话还没来得及说出口，张屠的手就猛地往下一按。
“咚。”
她整个人被压得往下折去，额头重重磕在地上。
一下。
又一下。
鲜血不断往外流。
她眼前发黑，只能扯着破掉的嗓子求饶：

“张爷……张爷，再给我两天，就两天……”
张屠这才把手一松，像扔一块烂布似的把她甩开。
周围几个小喽啰立刻哄笑起来。
“张哥仁慈！”
“这种贱货就是欠收拾！”
“规矩不懂，就打到懂！”
妇人刚想往后缩，张屠已经抬起脚。
在他眼里，这叫立规矩。
砰。
一脚踹在她肋下。
妇人整个人横着撞进墙角，闷响直往人骨头里钻，当场就蜷了下去，连气都快喘不上来了。
张屠低头看了一眼，抖了抖袖口上的灰：
“晦气。”
一个喽啰凑近几步，压低声音：
“张哥，最近巷钱抬得会不会太狠？尤其是三巷那一家，要是真把上面风声惹下来……”
另一个立刻笑骂：
“你脑子里塞草了？那顶炉的小子这几天不是挣着钱么？这种人，不狠狠干一刀，留着过年？”
张屠嘴角扯出一点笑。
那笑很浅，眼神却冷：
“没错。”

“这种货色，我一句话，他全家就得跪着把命送上来。”

The night was dark.
The oil lamp at the entrance of the dumb alley swayed twice in the wind, and the flame shrank, as if it would go out at any moment.
Zhang Tuzheng grabbed a woman by her hair and pressed her against the wall.
The woman's forehead was broken, and blood was smeared on the brick surface and dripping down the cracks in the wall.
Zhang Tu didn't yell, nor did he look too angry.
He just gently closed the bamboo board in his hand.
Snap.
Not loud.
But when this sound fell, several people around him shrank their necks subconsciously.
"Alley money."
Zhang Tu’s tone was calm:
"If you can't get it together tomorrow, your two sons will go to the alley and kneel down to learn the rules."
The woman was trembling all over and her lips were trembling. Before she could say anything, Zhang Tu's hand suddenly pressed down.
"Boom."
Her whole body was bent downwards, and her forehead hit the ground heavily.
one time.
Another click.
Blood kept flowing out.
Her eyesight turned black, and she could only plead for mercy with her broken voice:
"Master Zhang...Master Zhang, give me two more days, just two days..."
Only then did Zhang Tu loosen his grip and throw her away like a piece of rag.
Several minions around immediately burst into laughter.
"Brother Zhang is kind!"
"This bitch needs to be dealt with!"
"If you don't understand the rules, just beat them until you understand them!"
Just as the woman was about to shrink back, Zhang Tu had already raised his feet.
In his eyes, this is called establishing rules.
Bang.
Kicked her in the ribs.
The woman's whole body was slammed into the corner of the wall, and the muffled sound penetrated into the human bones. She curled up on the spot and could hardly breathe.
Zhang Tu lowered his head and shook the dust off his sleeves:
"Bad luck."
A minion took a few steps closer and lowered his voice:
"Brother Zhang, have you been raising money too harshly in the lanes recently? Especially the family in Lane Three, if they really stir up trouble from above..."
Another one immediately laughed and cursed:
"Are you confused? Isn't that guy who holds the stove making money these days? Why don't you give this guy a hard blow and save it for the New Year?"
A smile appeared on Zhang Tu's lips.
The smile was very shallow, but the eyes were cold:
"That's right."
"For this kind of thing, if I say a word, his whole family will kneel down and die."
